# Columns of the `m.indices` datasets

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Each section lists one dataset's columns in the order every verb returns them. **Supplied by** names the transports that fill a column; a column the serving transport does not fill is null. The wire-field columns name the Massive fields behind each column (`request` for a value the library fills from the request). The same descriptions appear in the web UI's column tooltips and in a query's `columns()`.

<a id="values"></a>

## `m.indices.values`

Index levels, tick by tick, as computed by the index providers.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field | Flat-file field | WebSocket field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. REST `ticker`: "Ticker of asset queried." FLAT_FILES `ticker`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under." WS `T`: "The assigned ticker of the index." | REST, flat files, WebSocket | `ticker` | `ticker` | `T` |
| `Timestamp` | Instant | The row's primary time, as an Instant. REST `last_updated`: "The nanosecond timestamp of when this information was updated." FLAT_FILES `timestamp`: "The timestamp in Unix MS." WS `t`: "The Timestamp in Unix MS." | REST, flat files, WebSocket | `last_updated` | `timestamp` | `t` |
| `Value` | double | Value of Index. | REST, flat files, WebSocket | `value` | `value` | `val` |

<a id="bars"></a>

## `m.indices.bars`

Open, high, low, and close index levels over fixed windows of time.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field | Flat-file field | WebSocket field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. REST `T`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under." REST: the request's `indicesTicker` parameter. FLAT_FILES `ticker`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under." WS `sym`: "The symbol representing the given index." | REST, flat files, WebSocket | `T`, request | `ticker` | `sym` |
| `Timestamp` | Instant | The start of the bar's window, as an Instant. A bar of a day or longer is stamped at 00:00 New York time of the day it starts on, on every source, whatever time of day the source stamps it with. REST `t`: "The Unix millisecond timestamp for the start of the aggregate window." FLAT_FILES `window_start`: "The Unix nanosecond timestamp for the start of the aggregate window." WS `s`: "The start timestamp of this aggregate window in Unix Milliseconds." | REST, flat files, WebSocket | `t` | `window_start` | `s` |
| `Volume` | double | Always null for `indices.bars`; supplied by `stocks.bars`, `options.bars`, `futures.bars`, `forex.bars`, `crypto.bars`. |  |  |  |  |
| `Open` | double | The open value for the symbol in the given time period. | REST, flat files, WebSocket | `o` | `open` | `o` |
| `Close` | double | The close value for the symbol in the given time period. | REST, flat files, WebSocket | `c` | `close` | `c` |
| `High` | double | The highest value for the symbol in the given time period. | REST, flat files, WebSocket | `h` | `high` | `h` |
| `Low` | double | The lowest value for the symbol in the given time period. | REST, flat files, WebSocket | `l` | `low` | `l` |
| `Transactions` | long | Always null for `indices.bars`; supplied by `stocks.bars`, `options.bars`, `futures.bars`, `forex.bars`, `crypto.bars`. |  |  |  |  |
| `Vwap` | double | Always null for `indices.bars`; supplied by `stocks.bars`, `options.bars`, `forex.bars`, `crypto.bars`. |  |  |  |  |
| `Otc` | boolean | Always null for `indices.bars`; supplied by `stocks.bars`. |  |  |  |  |
| `DecimalVolume` | String | Always null for `indices.bars`; supplied by `stocks.bars`. |  |  |  |  |
| `AccumulatedVolume` | long | Always null for `indices.bars`; supplied by `stocks.bars`, `options.bars`. |  |  |  |  |
| `AccumulatedDecimalVolume` | String | Always null for `indices.bars`; supplied by `stocks.bars`. |  |  |  |  |
| `OfficialOpen` | double | Today's official opening value. | WebSocket |  |  | `op` |

| `AverageTradeSize` | long | Always null for `indices.bars`; supplied by `stocks.bars`, `options.bars`, `crypto.bars`. |  |  |  |  |

<a id="snapshots"></a>

## `m.indices.snapshots`

The current state of each index: its level, its session so far, and its status.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. REST `ticker`: "Ticker of asset queried." | REST | `ticker` |
| `Error` | String | The error while looking for this ticker. | REST | `error` |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The nanosecond timestamp of when this information was updated. | REST | `last_updated` |
| `MarketStatus` | String | The market status for the market that trades this ticker. | REST | `market_status` |
| `Message` | String | The error message while looking for this ticker. | REST | `message` |
| `Name` | String | Name of Index. | REST | `name` |
| `SessionChange` | double | The value of the change for the index from the previous trading day. | REST | `session.change` |
| `SessionChangePercent` | double | The percent of the change for the index from the previous trading day. | REST | `session.change_percent` |
| `SessionClose` | double | The closing value for the index of the day. | REST | `session.close` |
| `SessionHigh` | double | The highest value for the index of the day. | REST | `session.high` |
| `SessionLow` | double | The lowest value for the index of the day. | REST | `session.low` |
| `SessionOpen` | double | The open value for the index of the day. | REST | `session.open` |
| `SessionPreviousClose` | double | The closing value for the index of previous trading day. | REST | `session.previous_close` |
| `Timeframe` | String | The time relevance of the data. | REST | `timeframe` |
| `Type` | String | The indices market. | REST | `type` |
| `Value` | double | Value of Index. | REST | `value` |

<a id="daily_open_close"></a>

## `m.indices.daily_open_close`

One day's opening, closing, high, and low levels of each index.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. REST `symbol`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under." | REST | `symbol` |
| `AfterHours` | double | The close value of the ticker symbol in after hours trading. | REST | `afterHours` |
| `Close` | double | The close value for the symbol in the given time period. | REST | `close` |
| `From` | LocalDate | The requested date. | REST | `from` |
| `High` | double | The highest value for the symbol in the given time period. | REST | `high` |
| `Low` | double | The lowest value for the symbol in the given time period. | REST | `low` |
| `Open` | double | The open value for the symbol in the given time period. | REST | `open` |
| `PreMarket` | double | The open value of the ticker symbol in pre-market trading. | REST | `preMarket` |
